==Quests== Talk to Torgon Blademaster in the [[Plane of Sky]]. You say, 'hail Torgon Blademaster' :''Torgon Blademaster says 'Greetings. Are you a true warrior? '' You say, 'I am a true warrior' :''Torgon Blademaster says 'Then you shall be tested as one. Choose. Do you wish to be tested by Falorn or Ogog?'' = Falorn = You say, 'i wish to be tested by falorn' :''Torgon Blademaster says 'So be it, warrior. Take this book and read it. When you are finished, hand it back to me and I shall summon the mighty warrior Falorn to test you. '' :''Torgon Blademaster says 'Falorn, come forth! '' :''Falorn says 'I am Falorn. Good day to thee. '' :''Torgon Blademaster says 'Farewell. '' You say, 'hail Falorn' :''Falorn says 'Do not waste my time, Xekl . Do you wish to take the test of blades or not? Or do you have one of my old trinkets you wish to trade in? '' You say, 'I have an old trinket to trade in' :''Falorn says 'Ahh, I've given out some lesser trinkets in the past that many have gotten bored with. I'm willing to accept Aerated Pauldrons in trade for Pauldrons of the Blue Sky. '' You say, 'I wish to take the test of blades' :''Falorn says 'The test of blades is not easy. I hope you are as powerful as you are brave. What do you wish to strive for? Strength, force, or skill? '' == Warrior Test of Strength == Falorn says 'Remember, true strength lies not only in the body, but in the mind as well. Return to me a bronze disc, a small pick, and a stone amulet. If you manage to do this, my runed wind amulet shall be yours. '''Reward:''' {{:Runed Wind Amulet}} {| style="margin-top: 10px;" cellpadding="4" cellspacing="0" border="1" !
